title: Siyi.app: Remember People
shortDescription: Remember the people you meet. Free, private, and no feed.
fullDescription:
Siyi.app helps you remember the people you meet and the context that makes the next conversation easier.

You meet more people in a month of college than in the years before it, and almost all of them fade by November. Not because you did not care — because meeting someone and keeping them are two different things.

Write one sentence the day you meet someone: where you met, one thing they said, anything you promised. Siyi reads the dates and promises out of it and brings that person back up when it matters — the week of their birthday, the day the favor is due, or after enough months of silence that you would want to know.

Add someone in seconds, save quick updates after a conversation, and keep follow-ups in order without streaks, scores, or guilt. Search names, contact details, notes, majors, residences, and tags. Choose reminder timing based on relationship strength or set a person-specific interval. Cached people stay available offline, and changes sync when your connection returns. Export your data as JSON or CSV, and delete your account directly from Settings.

Siyi.app is free, and it is private in a way a social app is not. Nobody you add is notified that they are in there. Nothing you write is shown to anyone, ranked, or scored. There is no feed and no public profile. Siyi.app does not run ads, sell personal information, or scrape social networks.

If you have been looking for a personal CRM that is not built around sales, this is that, for the people in your actual life.

Built by a small group of college students in Berkeley.
